scenes.text: Have you ever wondered what absolute silence actually sounds like, and did you know there is a room in Minnesota so quiet that nobody can survive inside it for more than forty-five minutes?
This special acoustic chamber absorbs over ninety-nine percent of all sound, meaning the silence becomes so incredibly heavy that your ears adapt and you start hearing things you never should.
Within minutes, you will clearly hear your blood rushing through your veins, your heartbeat echoing loudly, and even your bones scraping and grinding together every single time you make a move.
Without any external sounds, you quickly lose your physical balance and begin to hallucinate, so would you dare to sit here in the dark, or will you follow and comment your thoughts?
